# Native capture: Flow refire and another record's previous value

A fresh 30-day scratch org was created from a campaign Dev Hub and the synthetic project deployed. Project Flow, action, trigger and guard sources are API 62; ceiling files are their API 67 variants. API 67 Flow/action/trigger/guard was deployed first and test classes at 62 and 67 run, then all four were redeployed at API 62 and the 62 class rerun. A two-record after-save Flow invokes a synthetic action and updates its records, refiring an after-update trigger. That trigger records old/new values and attempts a guarded nested update of the second record. An overlength input provides a rejection control. Observations are JSON assertion payloads with identifiers, email addresses and URLs scrubbed. The scratch org was deleted and ScratchOrgInfo status verified as Deleted.
